verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-definable rules engine or workflow automation in which events trigger actions inside Moneybird. Webhooks ('get notified when something changes') and the API, CLI and MCP channels are developer building blocks that a user could build automation on top of. They are not the rule-based automation capability itself, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
